Abstract umbrella for syndromes across all systems; no organ or mechanism applies consistently enough to assign an axis.

Complex I metabolic deficiency; neurologic dysfunction includes hypertonia in 3/5. Respiratory failure in 2/5 does not establish intrinsic lung damage; renal anomalies in 1/5.
Osteochondrosis of the patella at the patellar tendon attachment.

Developmental or acquired impairment of receptive and expressive language; neurodevelopmental disorders belong to the neurologic axis.

Drug-induced oxidation of hemoglobin impairs oxygen carriage; hypoxic symptoms and secondary acidosis do not establish additional direct organ damage.

Absence of intestinal enteric ganglia causes severe intrinsic intestinal motility failure.
Carcinoma originating in the thyroid, an endocrine gland; no additional organ involvement is common across the umbrella.
